qualifier: granulocytic commitment and its negative regulation
name: Myeloid progenitor commitment and granulocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover myeloid progenitor proliferation/differentiation, granulopoiesis and neutrophil differentiation plus negative regulation of granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation, distinct from the erythroid-megakaryocyte, eosinophil/mast cell and monocyte-recruitment confusables.

qualifier: imprinting, X inactivation and piRNA heterochromatin
name: Germline chromatin reprogramming, imprinting and X inactivation
rationale: Members concern epigenetic resetting in germ cells and zygote (protamine exchange, sperm DNA condensation, PGC specification, piRNA transposon silencing, imprinting, X inactivation), whereas confusables centre on maternal-to-zygotic transition, oocyte and piRNA biogenesis.

qualifier: synthesis, transporter reuptake and degradation
name: Monoamine neurotransmitter synthesis, reuptake and degradation
rationale: Members span catecholamine/serotonin biosynthesis, SLC6 transporter uptake and vesicle loading, and MAO/COMT degradation, while confusables focus on BH4 cofactor synthesis, epinephrine/adrenal development or GABA transport.

qualifier: phenotypic switching, proliferation and migration
name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching, proliferation and migration
rationale: All members regulate vascular smooth muscle cell phenotype (switching, dedifferentiation, proliferation, migration, apoptosis), distinguishing them from cardiac muscle growth, aortic development and vascular remodeling confusables.

qualifier: membrane insertion, quality control and stress responses
name: ER protein insertion, quality control and stress responses
rationale: Members cover SRP/tail-anchored ER insertion, ER folding/ERAD and the UPR and integrated stress response, unlike confusables centred on COPI/COPII ER-Golgi traffic, cytosolic chaperonin/heat shock or FOXO signalling.

qualifier: endocrine and neuroendocrine differentiation
name: Pancreatic progenitor lineages and neuroendocrine differentiation
rationale: Members describe pancreatic progenitor gene regulation, endocrine (NEUROG3+, alpha cell) and exocrine development plus neuroendocrine/adrenal differentiation, unlike confusables on beta-cell secretion, definitive endoderm or gonad development.

qualifier: biosynthesis and fibril assembly
name: Regulation of collagen biosynthesis and fibril assembly
rationale: All members concern collagen synthesis, metabolic regulation (positive and negative) and fibril/ECM assembly, while confusables add crosslinking, elastic fibres, basement membrane or collagen degradation.

qualifier: initiation, polymerase regulation and break-induced replication
name: Mitotic DNA replication initiation and its regulation
rationale: Members centre on DNA replication initiation, unwinding and polymerase regulation in the mitotic cycle (plus break-induced replication), rather than the broader E2F/checkpoint cell-cycle programmes or DNA-damage checkpoints of the confusables.

qualifier: pulmonary surfactant and phosphatidylserine scrambling in apoptotic cell clearance
name: Surfactant homeostasis, phospholipid scrambling and apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Members combine surfactant metabolism and its genetic disorders with phospholipid translocation/scrambling, PS exposure, efferocytosis and plasma-membrane remodelling, unlike confusables on lung development or general membrane traffic.

qualifier: dermatan or keratan sulfate storage types (I, II, IV, VI, VII)
name: Mucopolysaccharidoses with dermatan or keratan sulfate storage
rationale: All members are MPS types I, II, IV, VI and VII, which store dermatan or keratan sulfate, whereas confusables carry the heparan-only Sanfilippo (MPS III) or hyaluronan MPS IX entries and generic GAG catabolism.

qualifier: intrinsic factor-mediated enterocyte uptake
name: Intrinsic factor-mediated intestinal cobalamin absorption
rationale: All three members concern dietary cobalamin transport into enterocytes via intrinsic factor (CBLIF), distinct from confusables on intracellular cobalamin metabolism, plasma transport disorders or other B vitamins.

qualifier: semaphorin-plexin and ephrin signalling, growth-cone collapse
name: Semaphorin-plexin and ephrin repulsive axon guidance
rationale: Members cover semaphorin-plexin and Eph-ephrin repulsion, growth-cone collapse, microtubule destabilisation and nerve branching/pruning, distinguishing them from netrin, Slit-Robo and L1-based guidance confusables.

qualifier: sarcolemmal costamere, T-tubule and cardiomyocyte junctions
name: Striated muscle contraction and sarcolemmal costamere organization
rationale: Members cover myofibril/thin-filament assembly and contraction together with sarcolemmal structures (dystrophin-glycoprotein complex, ILK-PINCH-parvin, caveolae/rafts, T-tubules, cardiomyocyte adhesion and gap junctions), unlike confusables on myogenic differentiation, SRF targets or desmosomes.

qualifier: TRiC/CCT chaperonin and prefoldin folding of actin and tubulin
name: Chaperonin-mediated protein folding and tubulin biogenesis
rationale: Members centre on TRiC/CCT and prefoldin-assisted de novo folding (actin, tubulin, G-beta), refolding and complex assembly, distinguishing them from confusables on aggrephagy/ubiquitin degradation or tubulin post-translational modification.

qualifier: lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and coenzyme A synthesis
name: Lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and coenzyme A synthesis
rationale: Members cover PDH, OGDH and OADH complexes, protein lipoylation and DLD, related lysine/glycine catabolism and pantothenate-CoA biosynthesis, while confusables focus on branched-chain ketoacid/biotin disorders, the TCA cycle or vitamin B6.

qualifier: intraciliary transport, axonemal dynein assembly and ciliary motility
name: Cilium assembly, intraciliary transport and ciliary motility
rationale: Members span basal body docking, IFT and ciliary cargo targeting, axoneme/dynein arm assembly and motile cilia/sperm flagellum function (CSF flow, mucociliary clearance), unlike confusables on centriole duplication/cilium disassembly, left-right patterning or tubulin modification.

qualifier: organellar sodium/proton exchangers
name: Organellar sodium/proton exchange and endomembrane lumen acidification
rationale: Members concern Na+/H+ exchangers (SLC9A6/A9 and their neurodevelopmental disorders) and acidification of endosome, Golgi and synaptic vesicle lumens, distinct from confusables on lysosomal V-ATPase pH, P-type ATPases, bicarbonate or chloride cotransport.

qualifier: proliferation, survival, stress hypertrophy and regeneration
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, hypertrophy and regeneration
rationale: All members regulate cardiac muscle cell proliferation, differentiation, growth, apoptosis, stress hypertrophy or regeneration, distinguishing them from cardiac fibroblast, heart morphogenesis and skeletal myogenesis confusables.

qualifier: FRS/SHC adaptor cascades with negative feedback
name: FGFR1 and FGFR4 adaptor signalling and negative feedback
rationale: Members are FRS- and SHC-mediated FGFR1/FGFR4 cascades, betaKlotho ligand binding and Sprouty/FGFRL1 negative regulation, whereas confusables cover FGFR2/FGFR3 signalling and PI3K/PLC cascades.

qualifier: subunit assembly and rRNA/mRNA modification
name: Mitochondrial ribosome assembly and RNA modification
rationale: Members cover mitoribosome small/large subunit assembly, mitochondrial rRNA and mRNA modification and translation promotion, distinct from confusables on mitochondrial tRNA processing, transcription, DNA replication or translation phases.

qualifier: ERK dephosphorylation and feedback inactivation
name: ERK dephosphorylation and MAPK negative feedback
rationale: Members concern ERK inactivation by tyrosine dephosphorylation, RSK activation and feedback/negative regulation of Ras-ERK signalling (incl. MAPK mutants), unlike confusables on RAS GAPs, RAF activation or threonine dephosphorylation.

qualifier: destruction-complex loss through APC truncation or AXIN1 deletion
name: Beta-catenin activation by APC or AXIN1 loss
rationale: All members concern canonical Wnt/beta-catenin output and its constitutive activation when the destruction complex fails through APC truncation or AXIN1 deletion, whereas confusables involve CTNNB1 phosphosite or AXIN missense mutants, GSK3B, and receptor-level Wnt regulation.

qualifier: second heart field, ventricle and septum formation
name: Second heart field specification and ventricular septal morphogenesis
rationale: All members concern early cardiogenesis from the second heart field through cardioblast proliferation, cardiac myoblast differentiation and ventricle/septum formation, unlike confusables on atrial, trabecular, endocardial, coronary and adult heart development.

qualifier: serotypes C, D and G
name: Botulinum neurotoxin serotypes C, D and G toxicity
rationale: The three members are the toxicity pathways of botulinum serotypes C, D and G, which block neurotransmitter release by cleaving neuronal SNARE proteins, distinct from the serotype A, B and E confusable and from general neurotransmitter release or cholinergic transmission sets.

core: Fibroblast and myofibroblast control in fibrotic repair
qualifier: TGF-beta response restraint and connective tissue replacement
name: Myofibroblast differentiation restraint in fibrotic tissue replacement
rationale: Members cover cardiac fibroblast differentiation, suppression of myofibroblast conversion and TGF-beta response, fibroblast apoptosis and connective tissue replacement in wound healing, unlike confusables on fibroblast migration, miRNA processing or collagen biosynthesis.
